app_summary: A social network with unidirectional follow relationships, implemented with loosely-coupled microservices, communicating with each other via Thrift RPCs. Supported Operations: Create text post (optional media: image, video, shortened URL, user tag), Read post, Read entire user timeline, Receive recommendations on which users to follow, Search database for user or post, Register/Login using user credentials, Follow/Unfollow user

symptoms.potential_symptom: Service has no backend pods and is unreachable, causing RPC connection refusals from callers

symptoms.potential_symptom: Pod experiencing repeated outbound Thrift RPC failures when calling user-service (connection refused), likely impacting compose operations

Logs from compose-post and nginx-thrift corroborate TCP connection refusals to user-service:9090. No evidence was found of pod crashloops, image pull errors, or node-level network problems; the absence of backends is due to desired state (zero replicas) rather than runtime failures. Based on these investigations the causal chain is: Deployment scaled to 0 -> no user-service pods -> Service Endpoints empty -> TCP connect to user-service:9090 refused -> compose-post and nginx RPC failures and client errors.
